Poster: Modeling Multiple Biomarkers — Correlation, Prognostic vs Predictive Value

METIMMOX-1 Economic Evaluation

Author

Ben Geisler

Published

June 20, 2026

Why TLR is excluded from the economic model. Target lesion reduction (TLR) is shown below as an illustrative third candidate, but it is not used as an economic treatment-selection biomarker for two reasons. (1) It lies on the causal pathway between treatment and survival — a post-randomization mediator — so building a selection strategy on it (or conditioning on it) would bias the estimated treatment effect. (2) It is a dynamic biomarker measured on follow-up imaging, i.e. not available at baseline before immunotherapy starts, so it cannot inform a pre-treatment treatment-selection decision. Only the two baseline biomarkers, CRP and TMB/BRAF, enter the economic model.
